caption: The drawing depicts a decorative, faceted glass container with a fitted lid. The lid is predominantly brown with gradients of lighter and darker shades, accented by ornate white patterns along the rim and the lower section. The body of the container has a hexagonal shape, with each face in a different color and design: one face is red with a symmetrical white floral motif, another face is blue with a similar white floral pattern, and the third visible face appears as a translucent or frosted pale gray-brown with less distinct decoration. The edges of the container are outlined in brown, and the white motifs are possibly etched or painted on the glass. The composition is centered on the object, which is isolated against an off-white or beige background. The artist has signed the work at the lower right corner.
title: Fireman's Candle Lamp
